cc:Work.dc:description: Each point is one complete trial, in A1/B1/A2/B2 execution order; no averages, pooled percentiles, fitted curves or cross-factor connections. Goodput counts accepted confirmations within the arrival window. Conditional accepted p99 includes scheduled queueing time but excludes not-sent, rejected, errored and unresolved arrivals. A dagger marks unavailable all-offered accepted p99. Status is copied from frozen summaries. Finite windows on shared cloud hosts establish neither sustained production capacity nor a bare matching-engine ceiling. The optional fourth comparison changes workers and total FIFO capacity together. Functional smoke and the 350k pilot are not formal points.
